evidence.quote: Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly from now on.

A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton enacts authority-ranking by mandating a cadence and framing non-rehearsed rollbacks as nonexistent — a rank-based directive that defines what the team does and does not possess.
Asserts a mandated cadence as settled fact, enacting the authority-ranking directive above it without re-performing the command.
Assigns a single named owner, enacting authority-ranking by locating accountability in one position-holder rather than distributing it.
